dct_title_s: Hydrographical basin of the upper Mississippi River: from astronomical and barometrical observations, surveys, and information
dct_alternative_sm: Hydrographical basin of the upper Mississippi River: from astronomical and barometrical observations, surveys, and information
dct_description_sm: Published by order of the U.S. House of Representatives (Washington). "Reduced and compiled under the direction of Col. J.J. Abert in the Bureau of the Corps of Topl. Engrs.; by Lieut. W.H. Emory from the map published in 1842 and from other authorities in 1843; C.B. Graham's Lithy."; Map to accompany Report intended to illustrate a map of the hydrological basin of the upper Mississippi River / J.N. Nicollet. Washington, 1845. (In House document, 28th Cong., 2d sess., no. 52).; Relief shown by hachures. Depths shown by isolines.; Library's copy is in two sections, joined horizontally.
